meta.name: ai-account-research
meta.description: 客户研究助手适合市场营销、运营、software、教育培训在用户提出“这个客户怎么切入”这类问题，需要快速拆解目标、判断重点并形成可执行结果时使用，帮助基于输入材料生成销售策略、沟通素材、跟进计划。

copy.tagline: 快速生成客户销售策略与跟进计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需分析客户背景并制定切入策略
copy.tagline_en: Generate sales strategies and follow-up plans from client research
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to analyze client background and craft engagement strategies

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，当你问“这个客户怎么切入”时，Claude 会基于你提供的研究目标、受众、网页链接或资料，生成销售策略、沟通素材和跟进计划。
howto.when: 当你提出“这个客户怎么切入”这类问题，或需要快速拆解目标、判断重点并形成可执行结果时触发。

say.text: 帮我研究一下这个客户怎么切入，目标是提升复购率。
say.note: Claude 会生成销售策略和跟进计划。

say.text: 分析这份客户资料，输出沟通素材和下一步动作。
say.note: Claude 会基于上传的资料提炼关键点。

howto.what_en: When you ask 'how to approach this customer', Claude will generate sales strategies, communication materials, and follow-up plans based on your research goal, audience, web links, or materials.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask 'how to approach this customer' or need to quickly break down goals, identify priorities, and produce actionable results.

say_en.text: Research this customer for me, goal is to increase repeat purchase rate.
say_en.note: Claude will generate sales strategy and follow-up plan.

say_en.text: Analyze this customer data and output communication materials and next steps.
say_en.note: Claude will extract key points from uploaded materials.
